recognize_zh: 淋巴結副皮質區見成簇、淡染的中型細胞（漿細胞樣樹突細胞，pDC），CD123 呈大片團塊陽性、granzyme B 與 CD68 散在陽性，但 BCL2 與 CD56 在團塊內為陰性，另有伴核碎屑的壞死灶，支持紅斑性狼瘡淋巴結炎而非腫瘤性 pDC。
features: Low power: follicular and paracortical hyperplasia with pale nodular paracortical aggregates
High power: clusters of medium-sized cells with round-oval nuclei, fine chromatin and moderate pale eosinophilic cytoplasm (plasmacytoid dendritic cells)
Focal paracortical necrosis with karyorrhectic nuclear debris and basophilic hematoxylin-body-like material
IHC: CD123 strongly highlights confluent pDC clusters; CD68 and granzyme B positive in the same areas
IHC: pDC clusters negative for BCL2 (BCL2-poor zone) and CD56
describe_en: Lymph node sections show follicular and paracortical hyperplasia with pale paracortical nodules composed of clusters of medium-sized cells with oval nuclei and moderate amphophilic cytoplasm. Focal paracortical necrosis with abundant karyorrhectic debris and hematoxylin bodies is present; neutrophils are not conspicuous. By immunohistochemistry, the clusters are CD123-positive with CD68 and granzyme B coexpression and are negative for BCL2 and CD56. Findings are consistent with reactive plasmacytoid dendritic cell hyperplasia in the setting of lupus lymphadenitis.

ddx.vs: Shares pDC clusters and karyorrhexis, but lacks hematoxylin bodies, plasma-cell rich infiltrate and serologic lupus; distinction often requires clinical/ANA correlation.
Neoplastic pDCs form diffuse sheets of blastoid cells that are CD56-positive, often TdT-positive and BCL2-positive, whereas these reactive clusters are CD56- and BCL2-negative.

ddx.dx: Myeloid neoplasm with mature pDC proliferation (e.g., CMML-associated)
ddx.vs: Occurs with an underlying myeloid neoplasm in marrow/blood and nodules may show clonal markers, unlike this reactive node with necrosis in a lupus patient.

ddx.dx: Hodgkin or T-cell lymphoma with necrosis
ddx.vs: Would show atypical large cells (CD30/CD15 or aberrant T-cell phenotype) rather than bland CD123-positive pDC clusters.

stain: H&E; IHC: CD123, CD68, granzyme B, BCL2, CD56
